Current status varies by source, and none of the snapshots I found is from today (October 17, 2026).

- **Pingoru** (polls Firecrawl's official status page every 5 minutes) reports the service up with no active incidents. It counts 5 outages since February 18, 2026, totaling about 3 hours 9 minutes, and its outage history lists a May 1, 2026 API degradation that was resolved within about 47 minutes. Last checked 1m ago; the most recent incident resolved 23d ago. Those two pages may have been captured at different times, so the most recent incident date is unclear.
- **Entireweb** lists Firecrawl as operating normally as of 13 August 2026, with no user reports in the prior 24 hours. That snapshot is about two months old.
- **StatusGator** shows a recent incident, Login and API access issues due to server errors, that lasted 16 minutes and was never officially acknowledged. Its 30-day count is 2 incidents, and it logged 68 over the past 12 months.

For live status, check Firecrawl's official status page at firecrawl.betteruptime.com, which the third-party trackers above all pull from.

content.text:
Yes, Firecrawl has had some incidents recently, but they were short and partial rather than full outages. As of today (Oct 17, 2026) its status page shows everything operational.

**Recent incidents from the official status page** (all on the API component):

| Date | Issue | Duration |
|---|---|---|
| Sep 15 | `/scrape` latency degraded | 46 min |
| Sep 05 | `/scrape` degraded | 7 min |
| Sep 03 | API degraded | 16 min |
| Aug 26 | `/interact` `prompt` field not working | 56 min |
| Jul 20 | `/interact` degraded | 44 min |

- **Latest incident:** The most recent one listed is Sep 15, about a month ago.
- **Third-party trackers:**
  - Pingoru has counted 5 outages since Feb 18, about 3 hours 9 minutes in total. It lists a May 1 API degradation that lasted about 47 minutes.
  - StatusGator logged a 16-minute login and API access issue that Firecrawl never officially acknowledged. It counts 2 incidents in the past 30 days and 68 over 12 months. That 30-day count doesn't match the official page, so some of what it logs may be minor or unofficial.
- **Gaps:** The status page doesn't clearly state whether each incident was resolved. I also didn't open the individual incident pages for details.

Sources:
- [Firecrawl status history](https://status.firecrawl.dev/history)
- [Pingoru: Firecrawl outage history](https://pingoru.io/providers/firecrawl/outage-history)
- [Pingoru: Is Firecrawl down?](https://pingoru.io/providers/firecrawl)
- [StatusGator: Firecrawl](https://statusgator.com/services/firecrawl)
- [Entireweb: Firecrawl status](https://www.entireweb.com/status/firecrawl)
